title: Midnight Sunwatch
text:
🌙 Midnight Sunwatch — November 06, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Moderate (C1.8​)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C5.6 (Peaked November 06, 2026 at 02:51 UTC)
🔥 Strongest recent flare: M3.5 (Peaked November 05, 2026 at 18:33 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 311 km/s (Calm)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 2.33)
🚨 NOAA Watch: Geomagnetic Storm Category G1 Predicted

Sunny spotted a flare! 🔥🌎

Today’s solar images show several active regions and a broad dark coronal structure spanning the central-to-southern disk.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 304 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
